description: Revise the certified Disengage fix after the Context Pack proved the prior authoring target was outside its materialized corridor; explicitly assign the existing ignore-cost decision to the System Bridge action-economy boundary.
planning_goal: For a committed full.disengage action, Frame Conn Turn state has already recorded the Full Action before effect execution. Execute the Disengage effect without consuming action economy a second time. The System Bridge action-economy boundary should use the existing ignore-cost mechanism when the authoritative current Turn state contains a matching unexecuted committed action. If there is no matching committed action, preserve ordinary action-economy behavior. Do not change Disengage status or suppression rules, targeting, or native Lancer behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The System Bridge action-economy boundary recognizes a matching unexecuted committed Turn action.
That matching action uses the existing action-economy ignore-cost mechanism during effect execution.
The already committed Full Action remains spent exactly once.
Without a matching unexecuted committed Turn action, ordinary action-economy behavior is unchanged.
Committed full.disengage executes its existing Disengage effect without a false failure caused by duplicate action-economy expenditure.
Disengage status, suppression, targeting, native Lancer behavior, and genuine failure behavior remain unchanged.
non_goals: Change action costs or turn limits.
Change Disengage duration or suppression semantics.
